g.text: ui: the views and the presentation state they keep
MainWindow passes every snapshot to every view, so that each history has no gaps
when its view is shown. A hidden view records the snapshot and repaints nothing.
ProcessModel is the one Qt item model: it updates only the rows and cells that changed.
The other views keep their presentation state, the histories of their charts, in
RingBuffers, and ask the *_formatting.h functions for every text they show.
Windows reaches the views only as domain values, and as the functions that main.cpp
passes in, such as the ProcessTerminator.
